title: Refrigerant Allowance Pounds for Consecutive Comfort Club Terms, Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
**Comfort Club program note.** On Repair and Emergency Service Calls, a member's unbroken run of Comfort Club terms adds pounds to the member's refrigerant allowance on a completed call. The count used is the number of consecutive terms on the member's Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements record, held without a break and counting the current term.

**Rule.** A member who has held the agreement for six or more consecutive terms adds 0.5 pound to the refrigerant allowance pounds. A member holding it for three to five consecutive terms adds 0.3 pound. A member holding it for fewer terms adds nothing. The pounds so added count toward the refrigerant allowance pounds before the pounds covered on the call are taken. A customer whose agreement is not active has no refrigerant allowance, and so nothing is added.

| Consecutive terms on an active agreement | Pounds added to the refrigerant allowance |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.5 pound |
| 3, 4 or 5 | 0.3 pound |
| 1 or 2 | Nothing |

## Boundaries

- A member in the 6th consecutive term adds 0.5 pound. In the 5th term the member adds 0.3 pound.
- A member in the 3rd consecutive term adds 0.3 pound. In the 2nd term the member adds nothing.

## Example (hypothetical)

A member in the 7th consecutive term of an active agreement adds 0.5 pound to the refrigerant allowance pounds. A member in the 4th consecutive term adds 0.3 pound.
